newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ADAMS'S TON HELPS HIS ENGLAND CAUSE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ADAMS'S TON HELPS HIS ENGLAND CAUSE.

text.p: Derbyshire's Chris Adams smashed a county cricket championship century at Durham on Thursday, boosting his chances of an England call-up.
The 107 saw Derbyshire finish the first day well on top. The midlands side made 254 before reducing the home team to just 109 for six at the close.
Australian Stuart Law's unbeaten 124 helped Essex to 204 for two against champions Leicestershire at Colchester.
After a disastrous start which saw Essex on nine for two, Law and England batsman Nasser Hussain put together an unbeaten third-wicket stand of 195.
Former England bowler Paul Taylor took five for 42 to leave Yorkshire in trouble on 163 for nine off 51 overs against Northamptonshire at Headingley.
Warwickshire reached 50 without loss off 16 overs, before rain brought play to a premature close against Sussex at Edgbaston.
Worcestershire made 58 for none against visitors Kent at New Road where, again, only 16 overs were possible, while no play was possible at Colwyn Bay, where Glamorgan play Nottinghamshire.
